name: chalk-server
description: Chalk AI whiteboard explainer video generator — Express API + BullMQ worker

scripts.// scripts: dev = hot-reload API (Docker CMD). build = tsc emit to dist/. start = run compiled JS in prod. db:* = Drizzle schema workflow.

dependencies.// --- HTTP layer ---: express = API framework (routes/controllers). cors = allow future client/ origin. helmet = secure headers. morgan = request logs. dotenv = load ../.env before lib/env.ts validates it.
dependencies.// --- Database (Postgres + Drizzle) ---: drizzle-orm = type-safe queries for videos/jobs tables. postgres = node-postgres driver used by lib/db.ts in Docker. @neondatabase/serverless = serverless-compatible driver option (kept for parity/future deploy).
dependencies.// --- Queue (Valkey + BullMQ) ---: bullmq = video-jobs queue (enqueue in controller, consume in worker). ioredis = Valkey/Redis client (Valkey speaks Redis protocol, REDIS_URL).
dependencies.// --- AI + HTTP client ---: openai = structured JSON outputs for planner/scriptwriter/sceneDesigner agents. axios = ElevenLabs TTS + Iconify icon downloads (needs timeout/retry control).
dependencies.// --- Validation + IDs ---: zod = runtime schemas for env + agents + API. drizzle-zod = derive insert/select Zod schemas from Drizzle tables (single source of truth in validators/). uuid = videoId/jobId generation (v4).

devDependencies.// --- Toolchain ---: typescript = tsc build (see tsconfig.json). tsx = dev hot-reload runner. @types/* = TS types for untyped libs. drizzle-kit = generate/migrate/studio CLI for Postgres.
